analyst.summary: Jubilant FoodWorks' (Domino's India franchisee) revenue growth is now being carried mostly by new-store openings rather than existing-store demand -- same-store sales growth has decelerated from 9.1% to 5% to just 2.5% over the last three quarters, below management's own 5-7% target band for the coming year. FY27 also brings fresh wage and commodity cost pressure that the company is only partly offsetting with a small price hike. At roughly 65 times trailing earnings, the stock is priced for a stronger growth and margin story than the company itself is currently guiding to, so we recommend continuing to Sell / stay out despite the underlying business (store network, brand, returns on capital) being fundamentally sound.
